summary: OCI cardholders' right to medical admissions; parity with NRIs under 2005/2009 notifications; challenge to 2021 notification restricting OCI eligibility to NRI/supernumerary seats; non-retrogression doctrine; Articles 14/21 rights claimed by non-citizens; State's sovereign power to prioritize citizens; NEET-UG admission parity upheld for petitioners via interim order; petition allowed to extent of preserving pre-2021 notification status.
legal_provisions_cited: Citizenship Act, 1955 s.7B(1), s.7D, s.8(1), s.9(1)
final_judgment: Impugned clause 4(ii) with proviso and explanation quashed to extent it denies parity with Indian citizens; OCI cardholders entitled to compete for general seats alongside NRIs as per pre-March 2021 position.
